description: Establishment of the Bangladesh-Sri Lanka Joint Consultative Commission for Comprehensive Cooperation between the Government of Bangladesh and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Bangladesh and the Government of Sri Lanka have agreed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on the Establishment of the Bangladesh-Sri Lanka Joint Consultative Commission for Comprehensive Cooperation between the two parties. The MoU seeks to achieve the objectives such as elevating the existing mechanism of political consultations to the foreign ministerial level effectively reviewing and evaluating all areas of ongoing bilateral cooperation. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Memorandum of Understanding. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment, and Tourism to sign the MoU on the establishment of the Bangladesh-Sri Lanka Joint Consultative Commission, was approved by the Cabinet.
